name: Ahl Almagharis
overview: "The work aims to deliver purposeful and direct messages about holding onto the land and the values of social solidarity in light of the harsh conditions experienced by citizens. Despite relying on simple rural capabilities, it represents an attempt to document daily lifestyle away from the hustle and bustle of the city."

trailers.title: البرومو التشويقي للفنان مبروك متاش في مسلسل الجمالية
